literal_meaning: পটভূমি বা মঞ্চের পর্দা (canvas or stage backdrop)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দেশের রাজনৈতিক পট দ্রুত পরিবর্তন হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The political backdrop of the country is changing rapidly.
The context of this incident is very complex.
note: This term is often used in formal or literary Bengali to denote situational context, derived from theatrical 'pat' meaning stage setting.
